subject: Stratos pilot — executive attendance alignment & calendar orchestration
messages:
From: Hannah Reid <hannah.reid@stratos.energy>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Liu <tom.liu@stratos.energy>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Exec availability for Stratos pilot demo (CIO + VP ask)

Hi Olga / Marcus —

Thanks again for the proposal deck. We're excited to move toward a pilot at Stratos. Before we lock dates I need to confirm exec-level attendance: our CIO (Rahul Mehta) and the VP of Grid Ops (Tom Liu) both want to sit in for the demo. Can you confirm whether you can accommodate a 45-minute slot that includes a 10–12 minute CTO/CIO-level overview, 20 minutes live demo, and 10–15 minutes Q&A?

Requested windows (Pacific time):
- Tue June 16, 11:00–11:45 PT
- Wed June 17, 15:00–15:45 PT

Also, can you share who from Redwood will present at the exec level and whether you'll have a brief run-through with our tech leads ahead of time? I've attached a simple attendee list so you can see roles.

Attachments: Stratos_attendees.xlsx (xlsx)

Best,
Hannah Reid
Director, Strategic Programs
Stratos Energy

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Reid <hannah.reid@stratos.energy>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec availability for Stratos pilot demo (CIO + VP ask)

Hi Hannah —

Thanks — we can cover those windows. Proposed approach:
- Presenters: Olga Petrov (SVP, Strategic Accounts) for the CIO-level overview, Marcus Lin (Product Lead, Inference Runtime) will lead the demo and tech Q&A.
- We recommend a 45-minute slot with a 15-minute exec-level overview to cover business outcomes and failover/fallback policies, then 20-minute live demo, then 10-minute Q&A.

Can you confirm which of the two windows works best for Rahul and Tom? If Rahul needs a later time we can offer Thu June 18, 09:30–10:15 PT as a fallback.

Marcus — are you able to do a quick 30-minute dry run with Tom's tech lead on Mon June 15? If so I'll hold a tentative 30-min slot on our calendar and we can release it if not required.

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0187

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Hannah Reid <hannah.reid@stratos.energy>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec availability for Stratos pilot demo (CIO + VP ask)

Thanks — I can do the demo. I recommend we run a 25–30 minute technical dry run with Tom's team to validate live data connectors and kernel selection for their workload (we noticed heavier seq length in the sample). Proposed dry-run: Mon June 15, 14:00–14:30 PT.

Agenda for dry-run:
- 5m introductions and success criteria
- 10–12m end-to-end demo on a small sample workload
- 10m validation/questions and runbook handoff

I'll create a short runbook and drop it in the shared Drive link below. If Tom's lead can't make that time we'll swap to Tue morning.

- Marcus
Marcus Lin
Product Lead, Inference Runtime
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Related link: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/stratos-demo-prep

From: Hannah Reid <hannah.reid@stratos.energy>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Liu <tom.liu@stratos.energy>, Rahul Mehta <rahul.mehta@stratos.energy>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec availability for Stratos pilot demo (CIO + VP ask)

Thanks, Olga and Marcus — quick update from my side after checking calendars:
- Rahul Mehta (CIO) can do Wed June 17 but only 15:00–15:45 PT if we keep to 45 minutes.
- Tom Liu (VP Grid Ops) has a conflict at 15:00 and asked whether Rahul could move by 30 minutes later (15:30). Rahul prefers 15:00, so Tom can instead delegate to his deputy, Priya Sharma (copied below).

Priya is the technical owner on the integration and will be able to attend the dry-run as well. We'll plan the dry-run Mon June 15 at 14:00 PT — Tom's deputy Priya will attend that.

Two quick asks:
1) Can Redwood include a short slide about fallback routing and SLA behavior for partial model variants (Rahul specifically flagged this).
2) Can you share a short PDF runbook for our ops team after the dry-run?

Attachments: Stratos_attendees.xlsx (updated)

Best,
Hannah

Subject: Re: Exec availability for Stratos pilot demo (CIO + VP ask)

Great — thanks for the confirmation. Finalizing logistics below: 

Confirmed demo (45m)- Wed June 17, 2026 | 15:00–15:45 PT (we will keep the slot strict to 45 minutes)
Attendees (Redwood): Olga Petrov (exec overview), Marcus Lin (demo), Grace O'Connor (customer success/ops — backup for Q&A)
Attendees (Stratos): Rahul Mehta (CIO), Priya Sharma (Deputy, Grid Ops), Tom Liu (VP - may send Priya)

Pre-demo dry-run (30m)- Mon June 15, 2026 | 14:00–14:30 PT — Marcus + Priya + Tom's deputy. Marcus will drop a 3-page runbook into the Drive after the session.

Action items:
- Marcus: prepare runbook PDF (2–3 pages) and test plan for connectors — due Mon Jun 15 morning.
- Olga: send calendar invite and attach the runbook and demo agenda.
- Hannah: confirm any additional security contacts who should be looped in for audit/QoS questions.

I've created a tentative calendar event and shared the Drive folder. Link: https://calendar.redwood.com/evt/abc123
Attachments to follow: redwood-demo-runbook.pdf (will be uploaded after dry-run)

If anything changes we'll pivot immediately but this should keep exec coverage solid.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Olga Petrov
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0187
